current_task_corrections.correction: Change financial_summary statistics parameter from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to report median, p90, and p99 percentiles alongside sums and means for paid_amount; skewed distributions require quantile reporting.
Add 'descriptive_only' to write_report caveats to state that the analysis is descriptive and supports no causal or operational conclusions.

reusable_lessons.lesson: Denial rate must be computed over adjudicated claims only (claim_status in {Paid, Denied, Adjusted}, excluding Pended). Record the denominator choice explicitly; including pending claims understates the rate and conflates adjudication outcomes with claim volume.

Key monthly volume trends on service_date_from (when care was delivered) rather than adjudication_date. Adjudication dates lag service delivery, creating temporal inconsistency and misaligned trend charts that appear to shift volume forward in time.

Report distribution quantiles (median, p90, p99) for amount columns (billed, allowed, paid, OOP). Financial claim amounts are typically right-skewed; sums and means alone obscure the distribution shape and outlier prevalence.
Include a descriptive_only caveat in all descriptive portfolio analyses to state explicitly that results are observational and support no causal, operational, or predictive conclusions.
